scope: Named fossil and renewable power plant geographic research baseline; no verified national census of plant-level assets
methodology: Fossil stations list historical ESDM evidence (2010–2023), ESDM named 2021 hydro sites and 2018/2024 geothermal roster, plus Medco 2025 company-installed, development and exploration phases. Group names and sites can overlap with investment/asset registries. Unlike approved RUPTL national GW targets, a named site is not proof of realized investment or in-service status in Oct 2026.
investment_policy: No unsigned/aggregate RUPTL GW/T rupiah totals allocated to individual sites. Report company nameplate when source supports, keep null otherwise.
